files.title: 2020 Barranquilla - Complejo Cultural de la Antigua Aduana Nacional
files.author: Felipe Restrepo Acosta

notes: Neoclassical customs house (Aduana Nacional, c.1921) on the riverfront (Cra 50 / Malecón), yellow with white trim, today a cultural center (Complejo Cultural de la Antigua Aduana). photo-1: three-quarter view of the main facade showing the neoclassical portico with pediment inscribed 'ADMINISTRACIÓN DE LA ADUANA' and the corner pavilion. photo-2: corner view showing the north flank plus portico end and dome of the complex. photo-3: close-up of the entrance portico columns and central door. photo-4: straight-on frontal elevation from across the street — cleanest reference for the main facade.
